{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the United States has a moral responsibility and national security imperative to prevent the spread of nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons, and eventually secure their elimination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has done precisely the opposite of preventing the spread of nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons and securing their elimination.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration's brash nuclear threats, ill-considered withdrawals from critical arms control treaties and nuclear agreements, and reckless embrace of a new arms race have made the United States, and the world, less safe.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thanks to President Trump's abdication of leadership, the nuclear dangers that Americans face are greater than they have been in decades.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats reject a return to an old era of grave nuclear dangers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that the sole purpose of the United States' nuclear arsenal should be to deter—and, if necessary, retaliate against—a nuclear attack.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to put the belief that the sole purpose of the United States' nuclear arsenal is to deter—and, if necessary, retaliate against—a nuclear attack into practice, in consultation with allies and the military.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to maintain a strong, credible deterrent while reducing overreliance and excessive expenditure on nuclear weapons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration's proposal to build new nuclear weapons is unnecessary, wasteful, and indefensible.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
